content.text:
I added the `AREnableSellMyCollectionArtwork` flag to `src/app/store/config/features.ts`. It is off in release builds because `readyForRelease` is `false`. On dev builds you can turn it on from the Dev Menu, since `showInDevMenu` is set. The type check and both feature-flag test files pass.

The flag doesn't hide anything yet. This branch has no Sell My Collection Artwork code, so nothing reads the flag so far. When you build the screens, wrap the new entry points like this:

```ts
const enableSellMyCollectionArtwork = useFeatureFlag("AREnableSellMyCollectionArtwork")
```

I didn't set an `echoFlagKey`. Add the flag to Echo and set that key when you flip `readyForRelease` to `true`. Nothing is committed.
